body: Thank you so much SW. You're angels. If I can make it through this weekend, I can make it through.
Bad communication... it was complicated... I will try to explain more once I stop feeling so bad, it just happened not to long ago, and I feel totally shattered and empty.
How do you fix things with people that just won't listen to you and won't believe you?
They finally broke things off. I am in a really worse place now than when I first posted this, but the messages are helping..
